subject: Throughput & warm-start commitments for Dedicated renewal
messages:
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@nimbusretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbusretail.com>
Date: 2028-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated renewal — capacity ask + throughput SLAs

Hi Ben / Lauren,

As we approach our renewal (end of September), procurement has asked for a formal proposal for the additional capacity and a clear throughput commitment so we can sign an updated SOW. A few specifics from our side:

- We expect an average sustained inference load of ~2k tokens/sec with spikes to ~6k for promotional windows.
- We'd like to reserve additional GPUs for predictable throughput: provisional ask of +8 A100-equivalent GPUs for the first 12 months.
- Pre-warm/warm-pool behaviour is critical — cold start latency during spikes is our biggest blocker. Can you describe warm pool size, prewarm window, and expected scale-up lag?

Procurement also wants a short mutual action plan so legal can budget for an addendum (pricing change + throughput SLA). Can you share a matrix of min/max replicas, warm-pool sizing options, and the impact on unit pricing?

Thanks — happy to set a call early next week if easier.

Best,
Tom
Tom Reed
Head of Platform Engineering, Nimbus Retail
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-10T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated renewal — capacity ask + throughput SLAs

Tom — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a compact matrix that maps reserved GPUs + warm-pool sizing to expected sustained throughput and price uplift (attachment: throughput_commit_matrix.xlsx). Also attaching a short SLA addendum template for warm-pool behaviour (attachment: warm_pool_sla_addendum.pdf).

High-level proposal (initial):
- Reserved: +8 A100-equivalent GPUs (12-month term)
- Warm pool options: 4 / 6 / 8 prewarmed instances. We recommend 6 as the midpoint for your spike profile.
- Min replicas: 2 (keeps base latency low for background traffic)
- Max replicas: 20 (headroom for extreme events)
- Scale-up lag: configurable — 30s / 45s / 60s tiers tied to warm-pool and cost. 30s tier requires larger warm-pool and premium credit.
- Throughput SLO: we can commit to a 95th-percentile sustained throughput target per model bundle (examples in attachment). For your stated profile, the 6-instance warm pool + +8 GPUs maps to ~2.7k tokens/sec sustained with burst headroom to ~6k.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement's acceptable warm-pool / scale-up-lag tier.
2) We produce a one-page amendment for legal with exact unit pricing.
3) Pilot week for traffic validation (optional) during the billing cycle prior to renewal.

Looping in Karthik to confirm infra/ops assumptions.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-11T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated renewal — capacity ask + throughput SLAs (internal ops notes)

Internal notes for Ben/Karthik / Lauren — quick feasibility sketch from the infra team:

- Model bundle: production uses rL-13B-quant; memory/kv-cache characteristics mean warm pool effectiveness is high for prefix-heavy traffic.
- Recommendation: min_replicas = 3 (we prefer 3 vs 2 for stability during continuous background traffic), max_replicas = 24 to limit risk of hitting headroom. We can cap at 18 if finance prefers a lower contract ceiling.
- Warm pool: 6 prewarmed workers matches Ben's midpoint; this yields sub-120ms tail token latencies during moderate spikes.
- Scale-up lag: true scale-up (spinning up new workers + model load) is ~45s median in our standard infra across regions; with prewarmed containers we can hit 25–35s. So 30s is feasible only if warm pool >=6 and we reserve an extra 2 GPUs for immediate burst.
- Cost impact: adding +8 GPUs with warm pool=6 -> ~22% uplift on current committed monthly.

I'll stand by for Ben to finalize the pricing tier. If Procurement asks for a 30s hard SLA, we need explicit prewarm sizing in the addendum and the extra reserved headroom called out.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@nimbusretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbusretail.com>
Date: 2028-08-12T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated renewal — capacity ask + throughput SLAs

Ben / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and detail. Procurement pushed back on a couple items:

- Max replicas 20+ feels open-ended from a budget perspective. They asked if we can cap the binding contract to max 18 and allow ad-hoc bursting above that with short-term spot billing.
- They want the scale-up SLA to be 30s for promo windows (we understand this drives cost). If 30s requires reserved headroom, please call that out in the addendum and provide the pricing delta.
- Throughput target: procurement would prefer a committed 95th-percentile of 2.5k tokens/sec (lower than Ben's 2.7k). Can you update the matrix with a pricing row that corresponds to 2.5k (and the warm-pool config that achieves it)?

On legal: they want a simple clause for credits: missing the SLO for sustained throughput for >6 hours in a 30-day window triggers a service credit equal to 10% of the monthly committed fee for each additional 6-hour window (capped at 50%).

We can schedule a short call with legal/procurement on Thursday to close language if you provide the pricing row and the addendum draft today.

Best,
Tom
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-16T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated renewal — capacity ask + throughput SLAs — mutual action plan

Tom — appreciate the clarity. Attached is an updated matrix and an addendum draft (renewal_multipage_so_terms.docx) that reflects procurement's asks and the infra constraints Rishi called out. Key points summarized below — this is the M.A.P. we've proposed for the renewal:

1) Capacity & term
- Reserved capacity: +8 A100-equivalent GPUs for 12 months starting on renewal effective date.
- Billing: committed monthly fee for reserved capacity; ad-hoc burst above contract billed at short-term spot rate.

2) Autoscaling & warm-pool
- Min replicas: 3 (baseline for background traffic)
- Max replicas (contracted ceiling): 18. Bursting above 18 permitted but invoiced separately.
- Warm pool: 6 prewarmed workers dedicated to your model bundle.
- Scale-up lag commitment: 35s guaranteed when warm pool = 6 + 2 reserved burst GPUs; 30s tier available as a premium option (requires warm pool 8 + additional reserved headroom, pricing in matrix).

3) Throughput SLO and credits
- Committed throughput: 2.5k tokens/sec (95th percentile per billing month) across agreed model bundle.
- Credits: If sustained throughput SLO is missed for >6 cumulative hours in a 30-day period, client receives 10% credit of monthly committed fee per 6-hour window, capped at 50%. Detailed measurement method is in the addendum.

4) Next steps
- I attached the updated pricing rows in the matrix (see 2.5k row) and the addendum draft.
- If Procurement is OK, we'll: (a) lock terms in DocuSign, (b) schedule a 3-day pilot traffic validation window post-signature to sanity-check throughput, (c) finalize calendar for rollout.

Please review and confirm if legal/procurement want any alternate wording. Happy to hop on a short call Thursday to finalize.

Thanks — will stand by to fast-track legal draft if you give the green light.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: renewal_multipage_so_terms.docx; throughput_commit_matrix.xlsx; warm_pool_sla_addendum.pdf
